title: MARLIN: De Novo Molecular Structure Elucidation from Tandem Mass Spectra without a Ground-Truth Formula
abstract: arXiv:2607.04774v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Untargeted tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) detects thousands of small molecules per biological sample, yet most go unidentified because they are absent from spectral libraries. These uncharacterized metabolites and natural products are precisely the compounds that matter for drug discovery, biomarker research, and exposomics. Computational de novo structure elucidation could close this gap, but almost all state-of-the-art methods assume the ground-truth molecular formula is known, an oracle that does not exist for genuinely novel compounds, whose formula must itself be predicted with substantial error. We present MARLIN, a de novo method that elucidates structures directly from a spectrum with no molecular formula at any stage. A self-supervised encoder predicts a molecular fingerprint from the raw peaks, and a block-diffusion language model generates candidate structures conditioned only on the fingerprint and the instrument-measur

translated_title: MARLIN：无需真实分子式的串联质谱从头分子结构解析方法
translated_abstract: 非靶向串联质谱（MS/MS）在每个生物样本中可检测到数千种小分子，但由于它们不在谱库中，大多数无法被鉴定。而这些未表征的代谢物和天然产物恰恰是药物发现、生物标志物研究和暴露组学领域最为关注的化合物。计算从头结构解析本可弥合这一空白，但几乎所有最先进的方法都假设真实（ground-truth）分子式是已知的——然而对于真正新颖的化合物，这种“先知”并不存在，其分子式本身也需要被预测，且误差相当大。我们提出MARLIN，一种从头方法，可在任何阶段都不依赖分子式的情况下直接从谱图解析结构。该方法利用自监督编码器从原始质谱峰预测分子指纹，并通过块扩散语言模型仅以分子指纹和仪器可测量的信息为条件生成候选分子结构。
tldr: MARLIN提出了一种无需真实分子式、直接从串联质谱图从头解析分子结构的新方法，通过自监督编码器预测分子指纹，并用块扩散语言模型生成候选结构，突破了现有方法依赖分子式这一不切实际假设的局限。
en_tdlr: MARLIN is a de novo structure elucidation method that directly predicts molecular structures from tandem mass spectra without requiring a ground-truth molecular formula, combining a self-supervised fingerprint encoder with a block-diffusion language model for candidate structure generation.
